power_contract.product_port: one S3 USB-C receptacle carries direct S3 USB2 data and sink-only power; C5/RP service VBUS cannot power or backfeed the board
power_contract.usb2_data: S3 GPIO19/20 remain direct to the product USB-C D-/D+ pair; TPS25751D GPIO4/5 and BQ25798 D+/D- are not connected to product USB data
power_contract.controller_boot: Raw connector VBUS reaches both TPS25751D VBUS and VBUS_IN. ADCIN1=LDO_3V3 and ADCIN2=GND select hardware SafeMode/address 0x20, so dead-battery LDO startup and the dedicated CAT24C512WI-GT3 address-0x50 image do not require S3; PPHV and charging remain off until a valid image is loaded
power_contract.configuration_update: field update verifies an owner-signed manifest before TPS FLxx writes and verifies the inactive EEPROM region. A blank EEPROM is not initialized by that update flow: factory/recovery instead preprograms the loose device or powers TPS from current-limited raw VBUS, confirms ReadyForPatch and I2Cc high-Z, then uses direct SDA/SCL/WP pads without externally driving LDO_3V3
power_contract.host_control: S3 SYS_I2C0 reaches TPS25751D I2Ct; its active-low pull-up IRQ shares the existing wired-low SYS_INT_N line without consuming GPIO47
power_contract.local_control: TPS25751D I2Cc owns BQ25798 and its dedicated EEPROM; charger INT returns to I2Cc_IRQ
power_contract.charge_limit: initial charge current is capped at 2A and may only increase after exact 18650 MPN, thermal path and per-cell admission/protection HIL
power_contract.failure_policy: invalid/missing PD image remains in hardware SafeMode with PD, PPHV and charging disabled; blank/corrupt-image, raw-VBUS-only startup and bounded recovery behavior require specimen HIL
power_contract.battery_topology: two individually replaceable qualified 18650 cells in a supervised 2S arrangement; both cells required for battery operation; working boundary 6.0V to 8.4V
power_contract.battery_holder_profile: Keystone Electronics 1048P is the exact prototype and production-reference holder: dual open SMT, mechanically polarized before contact, 86.0x39.8 mm, and intended for longer protected 18650 cells. The base product qualifies only exact protected button-top cell MPNs; raw flat-top cells are unsupported. Four physically separate slot contacts are routed independently and require specimen continuity/orientation proof before footprint freeze
power_contract.battery_thermal_coupling: PACK_NTC0 and PACK_NTC1 each use a dedicated electrically insulated compliant contact through an open holder window to the middle third of their own cell can. The independent BQ25798 TS NTC uses one of two indexed physical tongue locations and is populated on the thermally worst slot after placement analysis. Open/short/lifted contact blocks admission or charge; compression, insulation, response time and replacement-cycle HIL remain mandatory
power_contract.battery_manager: MAX17320G20+T 2S gauge/protector plus independently recoverable MSPM0C1104SDGS20R admission controller; G20 is I2C without SHA-256; blank/wrong gauge NVM or reset/watchdog MCU remains fail-closed
power_contract.battery_recovery_policy: base product refuses any cell below the qualified admission floor; MAX17320 zero-volt charge and linear prequal are disabled; any research recovery uses a separate isolated Controlled-Zone fixture
power_contract.manager_power_path: one active CSD87313DMST common-drain package provides the fully-switching CHG/DIS pair required by MAX17320; two 0451005.MRL slot fuses, WSL25125L000FEA 5mOhm shunt and two B57332V5103F360 cell NTCs are exact first targets
power_contract.manager_supply: MAX17320 AOLDO and isolated fixture enter BAV70LT1G; admitted system 3V3 enters BAT54-7-F and wins by lower drop; 2N7002DW-7-F asserts ALRT hold during MCU reset; source handover and current remain HIL gates
power_contract.rail_tree: BQ25798 SYS feeds independent fixed AON_SAFE_3V3, 3V3_MAIN, VVOICE_4V and 5V_EXT converters; 4V and 5V can never be selected by a shared feedback network
power_contract.aon_rail: TPS629203DRLR plus WPN201612H2R2MT generates 3.3V at >=15mA continuous and >=20mA transient from SYS using 2.5MHz auto-PFM/PWM; this includes the TPS25751 VIN_3V3 maximum active load plus safety logic, while MAX17320 AOLDO is not used as the product safety supply
power_contract.application_rails: three independent TPS564252DRLR channels generate 3V3_MAIN >=2.5A continuous/3.0A step, VVOICE_4V >=1.25A continuous/1.5A transient and 5V_EXT >=1.25A continuous with a bounded 2.0A post-start transient
power_contract.rail_inductors: MWSA0503S-3R3MT is the exact first target for 3V3_MAIN and VVOICE_4V; MWSA0503S-4R7MT is the exact first target for 5V_EXT
power_contract.converter_passive_profile: TPS629203 uses open FB/VSET for fixed 3.3V, RC0402FR-0742K2L on MODE/S-CONF for 2.5MHz auto-PFM/PWM AEE without discharge, one CGA5L1X7R1E475K160AC input capacitor and one GRM31CR71A226KE15L output capacitor. Each TPS564252 uses one GRM32ER71E226KE15L plus one C1005X7R1H104K050BB at VIN, two independent GRM32ER71E226KE15L output capacitors and one C0402C330J5GACTU feed-forward capacitor. Fixed 1% dividers are 45.3k/10k for nominal 3.318V main, 68k/12k for 4.000V voice and 220k/30k for 5.000V external
power_contract.quiet_switches: independent TPS22919DCKR instances gate the nRF group, CC1101, microSD, ES8311 and Si4732 branches with reset-off ON pulls and qualified QOD discharge
power_contract.switched_pg_qualification: separate MMBT3904-7-F stages qualify voice and accessory converter PG with their STOP-dominant EN requests; only EN high plus PG low may pull POWER_FAULT_N low, so a normally disabled rail is not a fault
power_contract.converter_control_passive_profile: TPS629203 EN is tied directly to admitted SYS and its PG has one RC0402FR-0747KL pull-up to AON_SAFE_3V3. TPS564252 EN defaults use one RC0402FR-0710KL per main, voice and accessory converter. POWER_FAULT_N has one RC0402FR-0710KL pull-up; voice and accessory PG each have their own RC0402FR-0710KL pull-up. Each MMBT3904 qualifier base uses one RC0402FR-0768KL series resistor. These nine physical resistors reuse three existing BOM MPNs
power_contract.diagnostic_load_profile: A 10-ohm CRCW251210R0JNEGIF pulse-proof load and DMN2056U-7 low-side switch sit across the fused 2S stack before the normally-open protection FETs. PA22 emits only an edge into channel 1 of TPUL2G223BQBR; its non-retriggerable output drives the MOSFET and ignores triggers while active. Exact 169-kOhm/220-nF C0G timing parts yield about 34.4 ms typical and a conservative 28.7-40.7 ms paper range including IC, initial-component and temperature tolerances. Production accepts only 25-50 ms, so firmware cannot extend one pulse beyond the accepted ceiling and the loaded ADC sample remains inside a measured pulse
power_contract.admission_adc_profile: MSPM0 internal 1.4-V reference measures midpoint on PA25/A2 through 2x220-kOhm over 169-kOhm plus 10-nF and full stack on PA26/A1 through 5x220-kOhm over 169-kOhm plus 10-nF. At 4.3/8.6-V fault-screen maxima and 1% resistor corners, ADC inputs remain below 1.21/1.17 V. PA24/A3 is released because the exact MSPM0C1104 datasheet forbids injection current on that physical contact
power_contract.charger_passive_profile: BQ25798 is physically strapped for 2S at 750kHz by RC0402FR-078K2L and MWSA0503S-2R2MT. Twelve independent GRM31CR71E106MA12L bulk capacitors, three C1005X7R1H104K050BB HF capacitors, two GRM155R71E473KA88D bootstrap capacitors, one CGA5L1X7R1E475K160AC REGN capacitor and one C0402C102K5RACTU SDRV capacitor implement the no-ship-FET/no-backup path. A 44.2k/100k ILIM divider bounds the physical input target to about 2.71-3.29A over REGN and resistor corners; negotiated IINDPM is always the lower limit. B57332V5103F360 plus 5.23k/30.1k provides a direct non-ignored charger TS gate; shared local-bus SCL/SDA use exact 2.2-kOhm TPS-LDO pull-ups, INT uses 10 kOhm, and reset-high CE pulls to REGN while TPS GPIO1 acts as an open-drain enable
power_contract.pd_support_profile: TPS25751D hardware SafeMode straps ADCIN1 high and ADCIN2 low for target address 0x20. Raw USB VBUS feeds both VBUS and VBUS_IN; PP5V is grounded for sink-only operation. VIN_3V3 uses AON_SAFE_3V3 after autonomous dead-battery startup. Exact 10-uF VIN/LDO capacitors, 4.7-uF VBUS, four 22-uF PPHV capacitors, 330-pF C0G per CC, EEPROM bypass/WP pull-up, 2.2-kOhm local and host I2C pull-ups and a 10-kOhm host IRQ pull-up complete the paper circuit. EEPROM address straps are low; GPIO0 is open-drain and may sink WP only in an authorized signed-update window; every unused TPS GPIO is grounded
power_contract.external_protection: TPS259470LRPWR follows the 5V converter and provides always-on reverse blocking, latch-off thermal-fault behavior and open-drain fault evidence. RC0402FR-072K21L sets a nominal 1.509A current limit that applies immediately at startup; GRM155R71H472KA01D limits the controlled startup slew. GRM188R71E224KA88D permits only a bounded post-start 2A transient; it does not defer startup current limiting. The exact OVLO divider, local capacitors and passive output bleeder complete the accepted paper profile
